bibl.title: Alexander the Great's name in contemporary Demotic sources.
bibl.note: Suite de: JEA 100 (2014) pp. 89-109. - Beside a number of elements which denote the existence of certain regional particularities or trends, the choice of a specific Demotic variant writing of Alexander’s name was during his reign essentially a matter of the personal preferences of the authors of the inscriptions or of the different scribal schools.
